parent_objective: source-balanced exact objective PPO smoke with existing snippet and trajectory anchors

public_gates: public proof gates only if exact source gate passes
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run longer PPO before the smoke passes
do not ignore protected-key source regression
do not run proof gates if exact source gate fails
hypothesis: Starting PPO from the source-calibrated M253 base may reduce the protected-key regression seen in M248, allowing a small PPO smoke to improve M223 and aggregate exact source loss without protected-key source regression.
success_criteria: post-PPO interpolation includes at least alpha 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.0
at least one alpha improves M223 source loss and aggregate M232 without protected-key source regression above +1e-8
run proof and behavior gates only for alphas that pass the exact source gate
failure_criteria: all alphas regress protected-key source loss
any exact-gated alpha fails proof retention

commands.name: m254_ppo_smoke
commands.command: Run a 1024-step PPO smoke from M253 using the M248 source-balanced recipe with a fresh seed, then exact-source-gate interpolated alphas.

decision_rule: Accept an interpolated PPO candidate only if exact source-aware objectives pass lexicographically and public proof/behavior gates retain M253; otherwise reject and audit PPO gradient conflict.
next_blocker: Run exact-source-gated PPO smoke from the M253 public-gate base.
